trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied string is within an attribute's max_length/min_length (or a string_length validation's bounds) is decided by counting graphemes with String.length/1, which does not bound codepoint/byte size; decided in Ash.Type.String/CiString constraint validation, the StringLength validation and the string_length expression function.

landing_point.why: The summary names the :string max_length constraint; the max_length clause of Ash.Type.String.validate/2 is where String.length/1 is compared to max_length.

fix_sites.entry_point: Ash.Changeset.for_create/for_update casting an attribute or argument of type :string with max_length (Ash.Type.String.apply_constraints/2)
same as above; length_ok? gates the match regex on length
Ash.Changeset.atomic_update / atomic update actions on a :string attribute (apply_atomic_constraints via lib/ash/changeset/changeset.ex:3847)
Ash.Type.cast_atomic for :string expressions (fix makes explicit :graphemes non-atomic, fix.diff:635-637)
changeset casting a :ci_string attribute/argument with max_length (Ash.Type.CiString.apply_constraints/2)
`validate string_length(:attr, max: n)` in a resource/action, non-atomic (also Ash.Query and Ash.ActionInput, lib/ash/resource/validation/string_length.ex:54)
same validation run atomically on update actions
string_length/1 in Ash.Expr evaluated in Elixir (ETS/Mnesia data layers, Ash.Expr.eval, atomic validations evaluated in Elixir)
compile of any Ash.Resource (new RequireStringLengthCountConfig transformer)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/ash/query/function/string_length.ex:20-26 (the string_length/1 expression function, used by the atomic validation at lib/ash/resource/validation/string_length.ex:105,121,137 and atomic constraints at lib/ash/type/string.ex:103,116,130,137)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: string_length/1 is a query/expression function whose meaning SQL data layers define themselves; changing it looks like changing query semantics rather than fixing a validation, and on Postgres it already counts codepoints.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Precomposed non-ASCII strings ("héllo" with max_length 5) must still pass under the default count, so a byte_size fix is over-broad; an explicit per-attribute/per-validation :graphemes choice must still accept a single combining grapheme; literal values must still be validated even when graphemes cannot be counted atomically.

O6_input_shapes: plain binary value through type constraints (lib/ash/type/string.ex:231)
atomic expression vs literal value on atomic update (fix.diff:314-321)
action argument vs attribute in the validation (lib/ash/resource/validation/string_length.ex:88-90)
invalid UTF-8 bytes counted one per byte (fix.diff:171)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Atomic updates of a :ci_string attribute: CiString.cast_atomic passes the value through and CiString has no apply_atomic_constraints override, so max_length/min_length are not applied at all to atomic expressions (or atomic literals) on :ci_string; the fix did not touch either.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Atomic constraints on :ci_string were never implemented, so it looks like a separate missing feature rather than the grapheme-counting bug; SQL data layers may have column limits.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package; lib/ash/type/ci_string.ex plus default lib/ash/type/type.ex:2259-2261 reached from lib/ash/changeset/changeset.ex:3847

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CiString apply_atomic_constraints that mirrors the pre-fix String version using string_length/1 without a unit
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding atomic parity for :ci_string would copy lib/ash/type/string.ex:94-154 verbatim.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-item string length cap in array constraints counted with String.length
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Array constraints already have length checks here; a string-item size shortcut would plausibly reuse String.length.
